resources.title: Workload and memory
resources.expected_hint: This estimate assumes the configured sampling interval and continuous data. Actual counts can differ.
resources.work_hint: The estimate includes selected targets and pending dependent observations. Actual work can vary with missing data, available history and how the checks execute.
resources.limit_hint: Configured limits: {{observations}} observations per period/preview target set, {{context}} observations per history buffer, and {{preview}} rows including context per preview.

limits.observations: The loaded period exceeds the observation limit. Choose a shorter period.
limits.contextBuffer: The stored check windows require a history buffer beyond the supported limit.
limits.previewRows: The loaded observations and context exceed the preview row limit.
limits.targets: The estimated affected observations exceed the preview target limit.

resources.heavy_hint: This selection may require several rounds of QC processing, or the requested period may exceed the observation limit. A shorter period or fewer selected checks can reduce work.
resources.unavailable: Memory measurement is unavailable in this browser or page. Workload counts remain available.
resources.failed: The memory measurement failed. You can retry; any previous reading remains visible.
resources.memory_hint: Measures this page’s memory use at the requested time. It does not show free RAM or memory available on the QC server. Only the first and latest readings are kept while this page is open; none are saved.
resources.backend_hint: These indicators are advisory. Browser memory and QC server capacity are separate; being within configured limits does not guarantee enough memory or a particular execution time.

qc.title: Edit & quality control
qc.description: Check the connection to the SaQC service.
qc.unavailable: The SaQC service is unavailable. Please try again.
qc.access_unavailable: Editing access could not be verified. Please try again.
qc.access_denied: This tool is unavailable or you no longer have editing access.
qc.graph_label: Original and draft observations with quality strips
qc.select_filtered: Select/unselect all observations in the current filter (all pages)
qc.parameters_hint: Positions follow the confirmed recipe. Parameter changes apply to this draft only. Unsupported parameters yield not run, never a pass.
qc.unsupported: This check is currently unsupported. Its result will be reported as not run.
qc.no_checks: No automatic checks in this recipe. You can edit values, validate data state and apply human review.
qc.discard_confirm: Discard all draft changes for this datastream? Export first if you want to keep them.
qc.live_only: Editing uses live observations. Leave snapshot mode to continue.
qc.reload_range: The date range changed. Load observations before editing or running checks.
qc.confirm_encoding: Editing is locked until you confirm that this datastream uses istSOS two-bit quality masks. Numeric quality scores and literal binary strings use different encodings.
qc.graph_hint: Click a point or brush a time interval to select observations. Drag the chart’s lower edge to resize.
qc.following_hint: following observations included because their checks depend on an edit
qc.table_hint: Edit Draft result and press Enter or leave the cell. Corrected values use filled-data bits. Automatic outcomes are read-only; use Human review for a manual decision.
qc.empty: Choose a datastream and load a UTC date range to begin.
qc.footer: Edits, Undo/Redo and audit history remain in page memory for this editing session. Leaving or refreshing starts a clean session. Export creates a file without writing observations to istSOS4.
qc.interval_hint: The interval includes both endpoints and all existing observations between them. No new records are created.
qc.edit_locked_encoding: Editing is locked. Inspect quality and confirm the source bitmask or start a new recipe above.
qc.operation_fill-constant: Fill missing values with a constant
qc.operation_fill-linear: Fill missing values by linear interpolation
qc.include_failed_anchors: Allow failed, pending or unknown-quality observations as anchors
qc.interpolation_hint: Uses actual timestamps and existing bounding observations; never extrapolates. For replacement, anchors must be outside the interval. Maximum duration applies to the complete gap and anchor span.
qc.audit_hint: Draft history for this datastream, retained in this browser tab and included in export. Undo, redo and discard add events; they do not erase history. This is not a permanent server audit trail.
qc.audit_truncated: First 100 observations shown. Export includes every change.
qc.inspect_hint: A numeric value can be a legacy score or a packed mask. Binary conversion alone cannot prove the encoding. Inspect the proposed decoding with the stored constraint order, then confirm or create a new recipe.
qc.inspection_counts: {{candidate}} compatible masks · {{unknown}} unknown/legacy · {{total}} observations including context
qc.raw_candidate: Raw / no-data candidates: choose up to three tests or confirm the existing schema.
qc.mixed_quality: Mixed quality values — confirm their source encoding before using one schema.
qc.legacy_quality: Legacy or unknown quality — create a new draft recipe.
qc.not_decodable: Does not fit this bitmask schema
qc.pair_order: Pairs are displayed from human review through checks N…1 to data state. A compatible number is only a candidate, not proof of bitmask encoding.
qc.new_recipe: Raw / legacy data: define a new recipe (0–3 tests)
qc.new_recipe_hint: Choose up to three test functions and their parameters. Starting the recipe resets automatic and human flags in the draft; source values and quality stay in the audit/export. The chosen order is fixed until you discard this draft. No tests is allowed for human review only.
qc.converted_schema: Draft conversion · {{count}} ordered tests · human pair {{human}}. The original quality is preserved. Discard the draft to change its schema.
qc.existing_schema: Confirmed source bitmask · {{count}} ordered tests · human pair {{human}}. Test positions remain fixed.
qc.human_hint: This changes only the human-review pair. Automatic results are retained. Editing this value later clears its current human verdict and records the change in the audit log.
qc.fixed_offset_hint: Fixed offset; no automatic daylight-saving changes. Changing the offset preserves the selected instants.
qc.audit_utc: Audit event times use UTC. Observation identities and original timestamps are retained.

workflow.automatic_bitmask: Quality is interpreted as an istSOS bitmask using this datastream’s stored checks. Original values and flags are preserved. Checks run when requested and rerun automatically after a value correction.
workflow.no_constrained_streams: No datastreams with configured quality constraints are available from this source.

bitmask_issues.no_constraints: This datastream no longer has configured quality constraints. Choose another datastream.
bitmask_issues.too_many_checks: This datastream has more than four checks. Its original quality is shown, but this editor cannot decode or modify that layout.
bitmask_issues.invalid_quality: Some quality flags do not fit the stored bitmask layout. Run checks on selected or all observations to rebuild their draft flags. Original flags are preserved; unchecked observations remain unchanged.

workflow.title: Edit & validate observations

hints.choose: Choose a datastream with configured quality constraints and the observations to inspect or correct.
hints.inspect: Inspect the original bitmask quality using the stored checks. Rerunning checks is optional.
hints.correct: Select observations, preview a correction, then apply it to your draft.
hints.validate: Recheck affected observations with stored parameters, then optionally make a human quality decision.
hints.review: Review values, quality and reasons before exporting. No data is uploaded.

workflow.stored_only: Definitions and parameters come from this datastream and are read-only. Select the checks to rerun; changing the selection does not change their bit positions.
workflow.no_stored_checks: No automatic tests are defined. You can correct values, validate the data state, and optionally perform human review.
workflow.check_unavailable: Unavailable for rerunning; recorded results are preserved.
workflow.encoding_hint: A number alone cannot identify the encoding. Confirm the datastream's convention; compatible values are not proof of a bitmask.
workflow.mode_existing_hint: Separate pairs describe data state, stored checks and human review.
workflow.mode_service_hint: Use the supplied sosraw catalog. No conversion to bitmasks.
workflow.incompatible_quality: Some values do not fit the stored bitmask layout. Resolve the source encoding or use service-code mode; no automatic conversion is performed.
workflow.confirm_first: Confirm the quality mode in Inspect quality first.
workflow.select_to_edit: Select observations on the chart or table, or choose an explicit time interval.
workflow.interval_scope: All existing observations in a time interval
workflow.recheck_next: Applying this correction automatically reruns supported checks on affected observations, including dependent observations.
workflow.flag_next: Choose a quality flag explicitly in the next step. Existing source quality remains in the original record.
workflow.catalog_hint: Supplied sosraw catalog. Choose a flag explicitly; these codes are categories, not numeric scores.
workflow.recorded_hint: These are stored flags, interpreted using the current datastream definition. They do not prove which historical parameters produced them. Inspect the table or rerun the stored checks.
workflow.service_inspect: Inspect the existing codes and their catalog descriptions in the observation table. Correcting a value will require a new quality decision.
workflow.run_all_stored_one: Run checks on the 1 loaded observation
workflow.run_all_stored_other: Run checks on all {{count}} loaded observations
workflow.check_scope_hint: Select observations in the graph or table, or explicitly check the whole loaded period. Neighbouring data may be read as context; only observations in the chosen scope receive updated flags.
workflow.no_code_mapping: Automatic results cannot be written as service flags without a defined mapping. Choose an appropriate catalog flag during manual review.
workflow.recheck_scope_one: 1 observation needs rechecking. Dependent observations are included automatically.
workflow.recheck_scope_other: {{count}} observations need rechecking. Dependent observations are included automatically.
workflow.no_pending: No pending draft validations. Recorded failures can still require attention.
workflow.review_optional_hint: Continuing never implies acceptance. Automatic results and human decisions remain distinct; any new decision requires a reason.
workflow.pending_export: This draft has outstanding checks or quality decisions. Export retains these pending states; it is not a fully validated result.
workflow.export_hint: Export a compact observation workbook or keep a detailed backup of this datastream’s draft and audit history.
workflow.unselected_pending: Only selected checks are rerun. Unselected affected checks remain pending. Missing data or insufficient context can produce “Not run”; this is not a pass.
workflow.cell_reason: Reason for cell corrections (enter before editing)

flags.101: Manual entry for the 2025 rain-gauge overwrite issue
flags.200: Reasonable range for the property and station
flags.230: Verified against nearby sensors or radar

skip_reasons.missing: An offset cannot be applied to a missing value.
skip_reasons.gap: The complete gap exceeds the duration limit or extends beyond the loaded context.
skip_reasons.anchors: A suitable numeric observation is needed before and after the interval or gap. Load a wider period or review anchor quality in Interpolation details.
skip_reasons.anchor_span: Bounding observations are {{minutes}} minutes apart, exceeding the {{maxMinutes}} minute limit. Increase Maximum gap / anchor span or narrow the interval.

explain.definition_hint: These are the current datastream parameters. A stored flag does not record historical execution settings.
explain.reason_unavailable: Reason not recorded. The stored flag alone does not explain why this outcome occurred.
explain.reason_pending: A value affecting this check changed. Its previous result no longer validates the current draft; rechecking is required.

reasons.history: Insufficient preceding observations for the configured window.
reasons.no_data: The observation has no usable value.
reasons.passed: This check passed when explicitly run on the draft.
reasons.failed: This check failed when explicitly run on the draft.
reasons.manual: This outcome was assigned through a manual decision.
reasons.buffer: The QC engine could not evaluate the available observations.

explain.recorded_hint: Recorded flags are decoded using the current datastream definition. Confirmation does not run checks or replace recorded quality.
explain.invalid_mask: This value does not fit the confirmed bitmask layout.
explain.service_pending: An explicit service quality decision is still needed for this draft.
explain.catalog_hint: Descriptions come from the supplied sosraw catalog. Codes are categories, not scores.
explain.pair_order: Pairs run from human review through checks N…1 to data state (rightmost pair).
explain.unknown_test: See the stored definition for this test.

tests.flagRange: Checks whether the observation lies within the configured minimum and maximum.
tests.flagConstants: Detects observations that remain constant or vary too little within the configured time window.
tests.flagZScore: Detects statistical outliers using the stored window, threshold and method.
tests.flagNAN: Checks whether the observation contains a usable value.
tests.flagJumps: Detects sudden changes using the configured threshold and window.
tests.flagByVariance: Checks how much observations vary within the configured time window.
